baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated J-L-D verb/unit, totalizing K-L-L, individuating W-H-D, and completed hundred turn a generic punitive command into a finite sentence separately borne by each named actor.

activation_trace.role: Skin-directed striking supplies both the commanded act and its countable unit.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the quantified rule cover each party without remainder.
Separateness individualizes liability instead of treating the pair as one undifferentiated body.
Completion at one hundred closes the measure at a stated numerical limit.

changed_reading.after: Administer an exactly closed, equal, and separately accounted bodily sentence to each actor.

baseline_models.mechanism: J-L-D names both skin and striking that reaches skin; its repetition frames force at the body's covering, while the numeral contains duration. The collocation therefore favors controlled surface-directed punishment over unbounded bodily destruction.

activation_trace.role: Skin as the body's covering supplies the material boundary on which the act is registered.
Striking the skin supplies the action constrained by that boundary.
The completed hundred gives the bounded action a terminus.

changed_reading.before: The verse authorizes severe bodily force in general.
changed_reading.after: The verse specifies a counted force registered at the bodily surface, with lexical and numerical boundaries against limitless violence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Tender mercy is grammatically cast as an agent that can take hold of the executors. The prohibition targets affective capture within the sphere of divine obedience and accounting, not the existence of tenderness itself.

activation_trace.role: Taking and holding gives tenderness the force of something that can seize the decision-maker.
Fine-grained compassionate tenderness supplies the live affect that could interrupt execution.
Obedience marks the institutional sphere in which feeling may not displace the command.
Accounting and requital make the scene one of answerable judgment rather than personal anger.

changed_reading.before: Do not feel compassion for them.
changed_reading.after: Do not let compassion capture and redirect the adjudicating role while the measured judgment is being carried out.

baseline_models.mechanism: Presence, informed attestation, and a bounded group combine to make punishment publicly knowable through a representative subset. The command creates accountable visibility rather than requiring exposure to an unlimited crowd.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct observation supplies the public body's immediate access to the event.
Knowledge-bearing testimony turns mere looking into accountable attestation.
A gathered portion of people supplies a bounded representative public rather than total communal exposure.
Trust and security qualify the witnessing group as a community of accountable confidence.

changed_reading.before: A crowd should watch the punishment.
changed_reading.after: A bounded believing public must be present so the measured act is observable, attestable, and not privately improvised.

baseline_models.mechanism: The immediate punishment is enclosed by obedience/accounting and a later decisive day. Earthly execution is serious but penultimate: actors, executors, and witnesses all stand under a further horizon of answerability.

activation_trace.role: Accounting and requital place the present sentence inside a larger economy of judgment.
A momentous event-day supplies the later horizon governing the present scene.
What comes after the first horizon prevents the earthly event from posing as final judgment.
Painful punishment names the immediate consequence whose authority remains subordinate to that horizon.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a self-contained earthly penalty.
changed_reading.after: The earthly sentence is a public but penultimate accounting performed by people who remain answerable at the later judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah casts the surah as imposed and clarified. F-R-D adds the images of a cut mark and an obligation bounded by a known limit, sharpening the focus numeral and skin-directed unit into a publicly disclosed statutory boundary.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the countable skin-directed act that receives statutory delimitation.
The completed hundred supplies the explicit endpoint of the measure.
A cut or notch supplies the image of a rule visibly scored with an edge rather than left open-ended.
A specified obligation supplies binding force at a known limit.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the penal boundary public and inspectable.

structural_cues: 24:1 immediately precedes the focus and describes the surah as sent down, imposed, and furnished with clarifying signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a marked, limited obligation and explicit clarification; I map that edge onto the focus's number and repeated J-L-D unit. A live alternative is that F-R-D contributes only generic obligatoriness, without the material image of a cut boundary.

changed_reading.before: One hundred is simply the amount commanded.
changed_reading.after: The hundred is the disclosed edge of an imposed rule: binding, countable, and closed against discretionary escalation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the focus actors in a gender-reversing pattern, places them in N-K-H pairings, invokes shared association, and closes with prohibition. The focus sanction thus enters a continuing relational perimeter, not only a momentary act-response pair.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the named female and male actors whose liability initially appears act-centered.
Four repeated actor nouns carry the same conduct into a patterned field of pairings.
Marriage-bond pairing supplies the durable relational structure around the conduct.
Association by affinity supplies the cross-household social linkage implicated by pairing.
Prohibition draws a perimeter around participation in that relational pattern.

structural_cues: 24:3 alternates male and female actor positions and ends by relating the pattern to the believers as a body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated actor nouns, pair-bond vocabulary, affinity, and prohibition; I infer that the sanction also protects a relational order. A live alternative is that 24:3 states a consequence or classification without extending the mechanism of 24:2.

changed_reading.before: The penalty answers an isolated prohibited act.
changed_reading.after: The penalty is one boundary within a wider order of pair-bonds, affiliations, and communal participation shaped by the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same J-L-D verb/unit immediately reappears for unsupported verbal accusation, now coupled to four witnesses and loss of testimonial acceptance. This mirror makes evidence control intrinsic to the focus scene: public witnessing restrains both concealed punishment and reckless accusation.

activation_trace.role: The focus's witness command supplies accountable public knowledge.
The focus supplies the skin-directed sanction later mirrored against accusers.
Casting words as accusation supplies the dangerous speech act that requires evidentiary restraint.
Preservation inside a protective enclosure supplies the reputation and person placed at risk by accusation.
Witnesses and testimony supply the knowledge threshold separating charge from established judgment.
The repeated sanction rebounds onto an accuser who fails the evidentiary threshold.
Refusal to accept later testimony makes credibility itself part of the sanctioning system.

structural_cues: 24:4 sets four witnesses, eighty strokes, and permanent non-acceptance of testimony beside the focus's hundred strokes and witnessing group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mirrored J-L-D sanction and explicit testimonial threshold; I infer that 24:2's public witnesses also supervise evidentiary legitimacy and execution. A live alternative is that their role is deterrent visibility only, while proof belongs wholly to the preceding adjudication.

changed_reading.before: Witnesses are spectators added after guilt and punishment are settled.
changed_reading.after: Witnessing belongs to an evidence-governed system that protects the accused from words and the sentenced from private or improvised force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah preserves several mercy channels around the focus: forgiveness after repentance and reform, sworn testimony that averts punishment, wisdom in judgment, divine R-A-F, and commanded pardon and graceful overlooking. The focus prohibition therefore blocks tenderness from canceling a duly reached sentence at one procedural stage; it does not make mercilessness a general norm.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies tender compassion as the affect barred from seizing the execution stage.
Judgment and accounting locate that prohibition within a defined role.
Covering the offense and protecting its bearer from its effect keeps restoration live after repentance and reform.
Formal sworn testimony supplies a lawful route by which the same named punishment is averted.
The recurrence of painful punishment identifies what the procedural testimony can block.
Judgment between people places mercy beside adjudicative wisdom rather than outside law.
The exact tenderness root returns as a divine attribute, preventing its blanket devaluation.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault supplies an explicitly commanded interpersonal mercy channel.
Graceful turning from an offense supplies another mercy practice outside the focus execution role.

structural_cues: 24:5 ties repentance to reform before forgiveness.
24:8 begins with branchless D-R-ʾ, explicitly saying punishment is averted by the wife's oath sequence.
24:10 and 24:20 pair recurring grace and mercy language with wisdom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both a stage-specific ban on R-A-F and repeated routes of forgiveness, aversion, pardon, and divine R-A-F; I infer differentiated institutional roles rather than contradiction. A live alternative is the narrower claim that mercy remains a divine prerogative while human executors simply apply the rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse opposes justice to compassion and asks the community to suppress mercy.
changed_reading.after: The verse prevents compassion from nullifying a duly adjudicated sentence while the surah routes mercy through proof safeguards, repentance, pardon, and divine restoration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation sequence portrays falsehood as reversal, speech received and relayed by tongues without knowledge, and indecency spreading through the community. Against that uncontrolled circulation, the focus's bounded witnessing group becomes an epistemic quarantine: visibility is authorized after proof, not salacious information released before proof.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-bearing attestation supplies the authorized form of public knowing.
A bounded portion of the public contains that knowledge within a defined witness body.
A lie turned away from truth supplies the corrupt informational object.
The four-witness demand supplies the threshold for converting allegation into warranted public knowledge.
Receiving and passing speech supplies the relay mechanism by which an unsupported claim travels.
The speaking organ supplies the mouth-to-mouth carrier of the relay.
Diffusion and dispersal supply the uncontrolled social spread opposed to bounded attestation.
Exceeding the proper limit marks the content and its spread as boundary-breaking.

structural_cues: 24:12 commands a good presumption and an explicit rejection of the lie.
24:13 requires four witnesses.
24:15 contrasts tongue-and-mouth relay with absent knowledge.
24:19 names the desired spread of indecency itself as punishable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proof threshold, bounded focus witnesses, and a relay-to-diffusion sequence; I infer that controlled post-proof visibility counteracts pre-proof rumor circulation. A live alternative is that public witnessing serves deterrence while the rumor passage addresses only speech ethics.

changed_reading.before: Public witnessing maximizes publicity around sexual wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Publicity is tightly sequenced: allegation is quarantined until proof, then a bounded witness body makes lawful judgment publicly accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, tongues, hands, and feet become witnesses, and God pays D-Y-N in full as truth. This recasts the human witness group as a provisional public attestation under an ultimate embodied record that neither accusation nor execution controls.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies human knowledge-bearing attestation at the earthly event.
The focus already places the event in a field of accounting and requital.
Testimony returns with the body itself as the bearer of decisive disclosure.
The speaking organ that earlier relayed rumor now supplies involuntary embodied evidence.
What the hands acquired supplies a bodily record of action.
Feet as bodily members extend testimony beyond verbal report.
Full payment without deficiency supplies the completeness absent from any human proceeding.
The same accounting root identifies the ultimate requital toward which the focus points.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the final standard against which human testimony is provisional.

structural_cues: 24:24 shifts testimony from a selected human group to the accused persons' own organs.
24:25 immediately joins full payment, D-Y-N, and repeated truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated Sh-H-D and D-Y-N across earthly and final scenes; I infer a hierarchy in which public human procedure is answerable to embodied divine disclosure. A live alternative is that the later scene is only eschatological confirmation, not a procedural critique of the earlier one.

changed_reading.before: The believing group supplies the decisive public account of the offense and sentence.
changed_reading.after: Their attestation is necessary but provisional; the body and final requital retain a fuller record that relativizes human certainty and power.

context_deltas.mechanism: House-entry permission, lowered sight, guarded bodily openings, facilitated marriage, and self-restraint form an ex ante architecture around the focus sanction. Punishment becomes a bounded backstop inside a social system that first regulates access, attention, privacy, and lawful provision.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the prohibited conduct addressed after it has occurred.
The focus supplies the retrospective sanction whose place in the wider system is revised.
Controlled entry into an interior supplies a first boundary around private space.
Permission supplies the gate determining whether access may occur.
Lowering by restraint supplies an upstream limit on visual acquisition.
Guarding sanctity and chastity supplies sustained protection of sexual boundaries.
The bodily opening between the legs gives that protective command its concrete anchor.
Actively arranging marriage supplies a constructive communal response rather than prohibition alone.
Refraining from what is unfitting supplies self-restraint where marriage is unavailable.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 regulate entry and permission before 24:30-31 regulate gaze, exposure, and concealment.
24:32-33 address marriage, material lack, and restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive controls on access, sight, bodily privacy, marriage, and restraint; I infer that the focus penalty is a downstream backstop within that prevention system. A live alternative is that these are independent etiquette and family rules with no causal bearing on 24:2.

changed_reading.before: The surah's sexual order is centered on punishment after violation.
changed_reading.after: The penalty is one terminal boundary in a larger prevention system built from privacy, consented access, disciplined attention, protection, and lawful support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus symmetrically names two agent nouns and assigns the measure to each one; 24:33 then explicitly distinguishes sexual exploitation, coercion, the women's own desire for protection, and mercy after coercion. That contrast makes culpable agency a live boundary on the focus's symmetry.

activation_trace.role: Parallel female and male agent nouns supply the focus's prima facie symmetry of responsible actors.
Each party considered separately makes individual agency, not merely presence in a pair, salient.
Sexual exploitation supplies the same domain under an expressly asymmetric power relation.
Forcing another into what she rejects supplies the decisive break between imposed conduct and chosen agency.
Will and desire identify the coerced women's own contrary orientation.
Seeking protective enclosure supplies the intended state opposed to exploitation.

structural_cues: 24:33 repeats coercion three times across verb and noun forms and places forgiveness after their coercion.
The focus says 'each one of the two,' whereas 24:33 explicitly distributes power and will asymmetrically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies symmetric agent nouns in 24:2 and explicit coerced conduct plus contrary will in 24:33; I infer that the focus symmetry presupposes culpable agency and cannot simply absorb a coerced person. A live alternative is that the passages regulate distinct cases without spelling out the legal relation between them.

changed_reading.before: Any female and male located in the prohibited event form the two subjects of the equal sentence.
changed_reading.after: The equal sentence addresses each culpable agent; the surah's explicit coercion case blocks mechanical transfer of that symmetry onto the coerced party.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later faith sequence contrasts verbal belief with turning away from judgment, selective submission when the right favors oneself, fear of judicial bias, and the believing response of hearing and obeying. The focus's 'if you believe' is thereby sharpened from zeal for punishment into fidelity to impartial adjudication even when outcomes are unwelcome.

activation_trace.role: The focus locates execution inside obedience rather than personal retaliation.
Belief as heart-settling assent supplies the condition later tested by conduct.
Claimed obedience supplies the profession that subsequent withdrawal exposes.
Judgment between people supplies the institutional process to which the parties are summoned.
Submission only when the right is favorable supplies the self-interested counterfeit of obedience.
Deviation in judgment names the bias that legitimate adjudication must exclude.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the believing response to judgment.
Actual obedience completes what the earlier verbal claim lacked.

structural_cues: 24:47 says people profess belief and obedience, then a group turns away.
24:48-51 stages summons, judgment, favorable self-interest, feared partiality, and the response 'we hear and obey.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later behavioral test of professed faith centered on impartial judgment; I map that test onto the focus's conditional 'if you believe.' A live alternative is that the later passage concerns obedience generally and does not specify the administration of this penalty.

changed_reading.before: Belief is proved by resolve not to soften the punishment.
changed_reading.after: Belief is proved by submitting the entire case to impartial judgment and then carrying out its bounded result, rather than favoring either severity or leniency for self-interest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise sequence joins enabled D-Y-N to replacement of fear with A-M-N. Because the focus also joins those roots, its public discipline is reoriented toward a trustworthy social order: enforcement may be firm, but its telos cannot be generalized terror.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the order of obedience within which punishment is administered.
Security and trust disclose a social dimension within the focus's belief vocabulary.
Empowerment supplies durable institutional capacity rather than episodic force.
The same obedient order is what the promise says will be established.
Anticipatory fear supplies the condition to be displaced, not reproduced as the final social state.
Faith and security converge in one root occurrence set, making trust the promised replacement for fear.

structural_cues: 24:55 promises to establish the believers' D-Y-N and explicitly replace their fear with security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared D-Y-N and A-M-N roots plus an explicit fear-to-security reversal; I infer that the focus discipline is bounded by a security-producing telos. A live alternative is that 24:55 concerns external communal safety rather than the affective effect of penal enforcement.

changed_reading.before: Public punishment secures order chiefly by making people afraid.
changed_reading.after: Firm public discipline is answerable to an order of trust and security; fear may deter, but generalized fear cannot be its governing end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Timed permission rules protect three private exposures and then describe household members as T-W-F circulators; collective business later requires remaining with the group until permission. Reuse of the focus's T-W-F root changes its witness group into a bounded, mobile representative public operating inside, not outside, privacy norms.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies a limited portion of believers commissioned to witness.
Direct presence supplies that group's public function.
Permission supplies a gate on access even for people normally moving through the household.
Protected exposure supplies the private domain that public circulation must not erase.
Routine circulation around people supplies a mobile rather than massed image for the shared root.
A matter or occasion that gathers people supplies a constituted public assembly.
Repeated permission governs departure from collective business, showing that public participation is structured.

structural_cues: 24:58 identifies three privacy times, then permits ordinary circulation outside them.
24:62 describes believers remaining at a collective matter until they request permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same T-W-F root in the focus group and household circulation, both framed by permission and collective-order rules; I infer bounded representative publicity. A live alternative is that the shared root is merely morphological and says nothing about the size or conduct of the focus witness group.

changed_reading.before: Public witness means opening the punishment to broad communal exposure.
changed_reading.after: A constituted subset bears mobile public oversight while the surah's permission and privacy boundaries continue to limit exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because M-ʾ-Y here is plainly the numeral, while its extension branch is form-distant. It remains anchored in the immediate collocation of the hundred with repeated J-L-D, but downstream prose should present it only as a material resonance that reinforces bounded distribution, never as an alternative legal meaning of the number.

activation_trace.role: Stretching a skin or container until it widens supplies an exploratory image of measured extension.
Skin as bodily covering gives that extension image a local material anchor.
The actual hundred branch keeps the resonance subordinate to the explicit completed count.

changed_reading.before: The hundred functions only as an abstract scalar.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, the count can be heard as distributing a finite sequence across the bodily covering, emphasizing extent and termination rather than explosive force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate and controlling A-Dh-B branch is painful punishment. The prevention/withholding branch remains anchored in the same focus noun and offers a coherent deterrent mechanism, but downstream prose must retain pain as the direct sense and qualify interruption or weaning as a secondary functional image.

activation_trace.role: Pain and punishment supply the direct event witnessed by the group.
Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply an exploratory account of what the painful consequence is meant to interrupt.
Public presence lets the interruptive effect address the community as well as the two subjects.

changed_reading.before: The punishment's function is exhausted by inflicting pain on the pair.
changed_reading.after: Alongside pain, the witnessed consequence may function as a public interruption meant to wean conduct away from repetition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because T-W-F B005 denotes a circulating night watch, whereas ṭāʾifa directly denotes a group. It remains anchored in the focus noun, its witness command, and the surah's later T-W-F circulation; downstream prose should call this a custodial resonance, not identify the group lexically or institutionally as patrol officers.

activation_trace.role: A keeper who circulates to watch supplies a custodial rather than entertainment-oriented image of the group.
Knowledge-bearing attestation gives the watch image a concrete accountability function.
Later routine circulation around community members keeps the mobile image visibly connected to the surah.

changed_reading.before: The group attends as spectators of a deterrent display.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the group attends as a custodial watch that makes execution answerable to informed communal oversight.

strongest_changes: The mirrored J-L-D sanction for unsupported accusation turns focus witnessing into evidentiary and execution oversight.
Recurring forgiveness, punishment-aversion, divine tenderness, pardon, and overlooking confine the ban on tenderness to the execution role rather than abolishing mercy.
Explicit sexual coercion in 24:33 makes culpable agency a necessary boundary on the focus's symmetrical 'each one of the two.'
Privacy, gaze, protection, marriage, and restraint reposition punishment as a downstream backstop within a preventive social architecture.
Later bodily testimony and full D-Y-N make human public judgment necessary but penultimate.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the focus's own roots in changed roles: J-L-D rebounds onto accusers, Sh-H-D moves from selected humans to bodily organs, D-Y-N moves from present obedience to full requital, R-ʾ-F returns as a divine attribute, A-M-N becomes social security, and T-W-F reappears as regulated circulation. Those recurrences produced procedural and institutional readings that a punishment-only baseline could not supply.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 24:3's pairing language directly revises the sanction mechanism or only describes a neighboring relational consequence.
How much procedural content belongs to the focus's witnessing group, as opposed to deterrent visibility after adjudication is complete.
Whether the fear-to-security reversal in 24:55 governs penal affect specifically or communal security more generally.
The material M-ʾ-Y extension and T-W-F watch resonances are traceable but should remain explicitly exploratory.
